def test_even_odd_count():
    # Mixed even and odd digits
    assert even_odd_count(-12) == (1, 1)
    assert even_odd_count(123) == (1, 2)

    # Zero has one even digit
    assert even_odd_count(0) == (1, 0)

    # All even digits
    assert even_odd_count(2468) == (4, 0)

    # All odd digits
    assert even_odd_count(1357) == (0, 4)

    # Negative numbers use absolute value
    assert even_odd_count(-2468) == (4, 0)
    assert even_odd_count(-135) == (0, 3)

    # Single digit numbers
    assert even_odd_count(7) == (0, 1)
    assert even_odd_count(8) == (1, 0)

    # Repeated digits
    assert even_odd_count(1000) == (3, 1)

    # All ten digits, balanced counts
    assert even_odd_count(1234567890) == (5, 5)

    print("All tests passed!")
